fields.description: The Opentree Foundation (TOF) is a Mumbai-based non-profit using play and play-based learning to empower children from marginalised communities. Through its Conscious Play® approach, we build life skills and emotional resilience in children, helping them grow into well-rounded adults. Our Life Skills Play Programmes transform classrooms into joyful spaces for learning and growth.
